title: HubSpot Seats and Credits Pricing in EMEA | IT SalesaaS
text:
November 10, 2026 · HubSpot

# HubSpot expands its seats and credits pricing pilot to all new customers in EMEA

HubSpot told investors on 4 November 2026 that its pricing pilot now covers all new customers in EMEA. The model drops separate hubs, sells one go-to-market seat and puts AI agents and other usage on a single credit balance. Existing customers stay outside it for now, and no date is set for the rest of the world.

## Key facts

Announced
: 4 November 2026, on the Q3 earnings call
Company
: HubSpot
What changed
: The pricing pilot was extended in Q4 to all new customers in EMEA
New model
: One GTM seat replaces separate hubs; usage runs on HubSpot Credits
Listed prices
: GTM seats from €20 (Starter), €100 (Professional) and €175 (Enterprise) per seat per month
Existing customers and other regions
: No date stated in the announcement

## What HubSpot announced

On its third quarter earnings call on 4 November, HubSpot CEO Yamini Rangan said the company is moving to a hybrid of seats and credits. The pilot began for new customers in the Nordics in April and in Benelux in June. In the fourth quarter it was extended to all new EMEA customers.

The pilot changes three things. A go-to-market seat gives access to all HubSpot capabilities, so buyers no longer purchase separate hubs. The price jump from Starter to Pro gets smaller across the Marketing, Content and Data Hubs. All usage-based features draw on one credit balance.

HubSpot's catalog supplement for this program, as read on 10 November, lists GTM seats from €20 per seat per month on Starter (10 paid seats at most), €100 on Professional and €175 on Enterprise. Included credits are 5,000, 10,000 or 15,000 a month, and unused credits do not roll over. Extra credits cost €0.010 each.

HubSpot says credit usage in the pilot regions is two to three times higher than elsewhere, with more Pro+ customers and a lower average selling price. These are company figures. Which countries count as EMEA and when existing customers might move are not stated in the announcement. HubSpot said it will share more in February.

...

For a sales leader, AI becomes a usage cost that has to be forecast. The supplement prices a Prospecting Agent outreach recommendation at 100 credits per lead, which is €1 at the extra credit rate. The 10,000 credits included with Professional would cover 100 such leads, while one-to-one emails from a connected inbox use none.

The call also says something about buyers. HubSpot described larger buying committees and longer cycles upmarket and more price sensitivity among smaller customers, and it expects that pressure to last into 2027. Our guide on how to sell usage-based pricing covers the cost questions buyers now raise.

European teams see this model first, so they are effectively the test market. US buyers have no date, and terms may change before a wider rollout.

title: HubSpot Product and Pricing Changes | HeadsUp
text:
# What HubSpot changed

328 changes since July 2025. The most recent was Nov 13, 2026.

Nov 13, 2026

## HubSpot rebrands as "The Customer Relationship Harness"

What changed

- The main headline changed from "Build demand, win deals, and delight customers" to "HubSpot: The Customer Relationship Harness."
- The sub-headline was rewritten to emphasize that while AI knows the world, HubSpot knows "your world" (your specific business data).
- The phrase "HubSpot Agentic Customer Platform" was replaced with "The New Way to Grow."
- The new copy highlights that AI can now "get work done" across different tools, not just inside HubSpot.

Why it matters

HubSpot is shifting its messaging from being a simple "platform" to a "harness" that connects general AI with specific business data. This suggests they are positioning their proprietary data as the essential ingredient that makes AI actually useful for companies.

Nov 11, 2026

## HubSpot launches credit-based pricing for AI

- Introduced a new "HubSpot Credits" system where credits are used when AI features take action.
- Added specific credit allotments to plans: 500 for Starter, 3,000 for Professional, and 5,000 for Enterprise.
- Updated the Sales Hub pricing page to highlight "Deal journey analytics" and "Deal Progression" features.
- Changed the primary navigation links to point directly to pricing pages rather than product overviews.
- Added a promotional bundle offering Revenue Hub at a discount when purchased with Sales Hub.

Why it matters

HubSpot is shifting how it charges for AI features. Instead of just flat monthly fees, they are introducing "HubSpot Credits." This means users pay based on how much work the AI agents actually do, which could change how customers budget for automation.

Nov 10, 2026

## HubSpot Sales Hub adds Agent Builder to plans HubSpot launches dedicated Free Meeting Scheduler

- Added "Agent Builder" to Starter, Professional, and Enterprise plans for Sales Hub.
- Starter users can now build custom agents with simple automation.
- Professional and Enterprise users get advanced agents with event-based triggers.
- Updated the pricing table to show specific limits for features like calling minutes, email templates (up to 10,000), and sales pipelines (up to 350).
- Added new integration mentions for Microsoft Teams, Amplitude, and Adobe Express.
- Removed several promotional banners for "Revenue Hub" and "Small Business Bundles" from the main sales pricing view.
- Replaced the general "Customer Platform" homepage content with a dedicated page for the Free Meeting Scheduler.
- Added specific features for the scheduler, including round-robin booking, group links, and AI-powered meeting prep.
- Updated navigation links to point directly to the meeting scheduler tool instead of general product pages.
- Added a "Related Resources" section with guides on automating meeting follow-ups and setting up team links.
- Included a new FAQ section specifically addressing meeting scheduling software.

Why it matters

HubSpot is moving away from simple tools toward an "agentic" platform. By adding the Agent Builder to paid tiers, they are letting users create their own custom AI bots to handle sales tasks, which could make their software much harder for customers to leave.

HubSpot is shifting focus from a general platform overview to a specific, high-intent tool. By highlighting the meeting scheduler, they are targeting a common pain point to capture leads who might otherwise use standalone tools like Calendly.

text:
Chief Executive Officer Yamini Rangan said customers increasingly want to test AI products with their own data before committing to a purchase. HubSpot has introduced trials and pricing tied more closely to outcomes, a strategy she said can lengthen buying cycles but supports longer-term adoption.

## AI Adoption and Pricing Pilot

Rangan pointed to rising use of HubSpot’s AI products as evidence of progress. Agent trials grew 64% sequentially in the third quarter, while monthly credit consumption was up nearly 2.5 times from the beginning of the year. Twenty percent of Pro+ customers used HubSpot Agents, up 11 percentage points since the start of 2026.

The company is adding support from partners and solution consultants to help larger customers turn trials into paid use. For smaller customers, Rangan said HubSpot is focusing on simpler onboarding and pricing rather than deploying consultants.

HubSpot is testing a pricing model that combines seats with credits for usage-based features. In pilots in the Nordics and Benelux, credit consumption was two to three times higher than in regions outside the pilot. Pro+ customer volume was higher, while average selling prices were lower, Rangan said.

The pilot expanded across Europe, the Middle East and Africa in the fourth quarter for new customers. Rangan said HubSpot will evaluate adoption, credit usage, retention and new annual recurring revenue before deciding when to roll it out more broadly. The company has not set a migration timeline for existing customers.

title: HubSpot Pricing UK 2026: Plans and Costs | PEF
text:
## HubSpot pricing in the UK has changed: one platform, priced per seat

If you last looked at HubSpot pricing a year or two ago, forget most of what you remember. The hubs are still there as products: Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Data Hub (which used to be Operations Hub), Revenue Hub (which used to be Commerce Hub) and the newer Agent Hub. But when I opened hubspot.com’s pricing from the UK in November 2026, the individual hub pricing pages redirected to a single page headed Sales, Marketing and Service, all together, with one set of prices in pounds.

The model has three parts. First, an edition: Free, Starter, Professional or Enterprise, which sets the feature level for the whole account. Second, seats: every paid user needs one, and the edition sets the seat price. HubSpot’s published supplement for this model calls the main seat a GTM Seat, with full marketing, sales and service access, and adds an Ops Seat for automation, reporting and governance on Professional and Enterprise. Third, HubSpot Credits: a monthly allowance that marketing email sends, workflow actions, calling minutes and AI agents consume, with more available in packs or pay as you go.

Two older ideas have gone for new customers on this model. Marketing contact tiers are no longer bought separately; marketing contacts count as a record type within an edition’s record capacity of 25,000 records on Starter, 250,000 on Professional and 15 million on Enterprise. And there is no separate base fee per hub. Customers on older contracts still see hub by hub prices with Core, Sales and Service seats and contact tiers, and HubSpot’s product catalogue documents both models side by side, with the legacy figures in US dollars.

## HubSpot UK prices by edition, as shown in November 2026

These are the figures hubspot.com showed me in pounds, per seat per month. Treat them all as before VAT.

- Free: £0 for up to two users, with HubSpot branding on emails, forms and meeting links and a cap of 2,000 marketing emails a month.
- Starter: £7 per seat per month billed annually, labelled as a limited time 65 per cent discount for new customers, or £9 per seat per month billed monthly at 50 per cent off. Up to ten paid users, 5,000 credits a month, email and chat support. The page does not show the undiscounted sterling price, so ask what the seat will cost at renewal before you rely on £7.
- Professional: £81 per seat per month billed annually or £90 billed monthly, additional seats at the same rate, 10,000 credits a month, phone support added, and the automation, sequences, forecasting, Marketing Studio and Help Desk features most growing companies actually want.
- Enterprise: £155 per seat per month on either billing basis, 15,000 credits a month, plus a sandbox account, field level permissions, single sign on, approvals, 300 teams and up to 30 connected HubSpot accounts.

## Comprendre la nouvelle tarification HubSpot en 2026 : sièges, hubs et crédits

Jusqu’en septembre 2026, un abonnement HubSpot se composait hub par hub. Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub et Data Hub avaient chacun leur édition, leurs sièges et leurs limites. Le budget dépendait du nombre de hubs achetés.

Depuis le 1er octobre 2026, un nouveau client de la zone EMEA, France comprise, achète la plateforme client entière dans une seule édition. HubSpot présente ce modèle comme une facturation plus prévisible. Elle repose sur trois éléments :

- Les sièges, attribués selon le rôle de chaque utilisateur.
- Les crédits HubSpot, qui paient le travail exécuté par la plateforme : emails, actions de workflow, agents IA.
- La capacité d’enregistrements, c’est-à-dire le volume de fiches stockées dans le CRM.

Vous ne payez plus des hubs. Vous payez des personnes, leur rôle et l’usage réel de la plateforme.

Quatre termes reviennent dans tous les devis HubSpot. Voici leur définition :

| Terme | Définition |
| --- | --- |
| Core Seat | Siège de base de l’ancienne grille. Il donnait accès aux outils partagés de tous les hubs achetés, sans les fonctions avancées de vente ou de service. |
| GTM Seat | Siège go-to-market du nouveau modèle. Il ouvre toute la plateforme de l’édition aux équipes qui travaillent avec les clients. |
| Crédits HubSpot | Monnaie interne de la plateforme. Un crédit vaut 0,01 € et paie les emails, les actions de workflow et les agents IA. |
| View-only Seat | Siège en lecture seule, gratuit. Il permet de consulter fiches et tableaux de bord sans rien modifier. |

Ce changement rend la facture plus juste pour une petite équipe qui fait du marketing, de la vente et du service à la fois. Il la rend aussi plus variable pour une entreprise qui envoie beaucoup d’emails ou automatise beaucoup.

title: HubSpot Agent Hub: What the Agents Do and Where Humans Stay
text:
## What Agent Hub is

On 23 July 2026, HubSpot moved its Breeze Agents into a new home called Agent Hub, and renamed Breeze Studio to Agent Builder. Both are in public beta for Professional and Enterprise plans. Breeze Assistant kept its name.

Agent Hub gives you one view of every agent running across marketing, sales and service: what is active, what it is doing and what it produced, according to Integrate IQ’s write-up of the Fall Spotlight. HubSpot says it does not need a separate licence.

The line-up is the Customer Agent, the Prospecting Agent and the Data Agent, plus three new marketing agents and a Revenue Agent in public beta. Demand Gen Playbook reports that the Prospecting Agent now watches more than 40 buying signals.

## What it costs

Agents run on credits, and credits cost $0.01 each beyond your monthly allowance, according to HubSpot’s pricing page. That page lists 3,000 included credits on Professional and 5,000 on Enterprise. Some sources, including Eesel’s pricing breakdown, put the per-action costs at 100 credits for a Prospecting Agent recommendation on one lead, 50 for a Customer Agent resolved conversation, 10 for a Data Agent prompt about one record and 1,000 for a piece of content from the beta Content Agent. At a cent a credit, that is about $1 a lead and 50 cents a resolution, which matches the pay-per-result prices CMSWire reported for April. Some sources add that agents which were free during the beta now consume credits.

On 15 October, HubSpot announced spend caps, seat-to-credit swaps and flex payment options for exactly this reason: AI usage is growing and customers wanted a ceiling. Set the cap before you switch the agent on, not after the first bill.

...

Beta is the other one. Agent Builder and parts of Agent Hub are in public beta, so features, names and pricing have already changed once this year. Pilot with one agent and one workflow. Do not rebuild your whole outbound motion on a beta.
